_about: Quick facts on each lake home page, written into the HTML by tools/build-lake-pages.py (no JavaScript). Every line is copied from text the site already sources (water.html lake facts cards, the home page map notes and How to read this, js/lake-map-data-*.js); the gauge link comes from js/lakes.js. docks (optional) = a dated end of season dock line under Ramps and access, from an official page, or a news story quoting the agency when D'Angelo approves it, named as such in the text (checked, text, source [label, url]). Leave a field out when there is no official source. checked = the date the facts were last checked against the sources listed; it also becomes the page's WebPage dateModified. title and description are that lake home page's <title> and meta description (Hoover's page is hoover/ since the site root became the water picker), written by tools/build-lake-pages.py. hours (optional) = the night-rules chip under the hero (js/night-rules.js): authority (city, odnr, mwcd), open and close as HH:MM 24h ET or sunrise/sunset (null when the source gives no clock time), fishing_after_hours (true only when the source says so, else null), chip (short line), source [label, url] (the official page that states it), checked. {none: true, note} = no official page states hours; the Night rules row says so and no chip shows. tools/check-hours.py checks every entry.
